findings.finding: Streeterville Capital's floating-price convertible note (from 2026-08-26, $4.33m principal) keeps a conversion seller in the ADSs on every session, 2026-09-29 included. The conversion price resets down with the lowest 10-day VWAP and sits about 13% below spot, so the holder can profitably convert and sell into any bounce.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Conversion is at the lender's option on any trading day and the note is not due until 2027, so the 2026-09-29 session carries the same supply as today. No filing shows the seller has finished: the last 13G/A already sits at the 9.99% cap, which means converting and selling in rotation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the note was issued: of the 12 baseline falls from 2026-08-20 on, 10 were followed by another decline or a flat next close (median next close about -5.7%). The 2026-08-26 fall of -38.55%, on the note's issue day, was followed by -26.71%. Earlier notes of the same kind were filed 2026-04-30 and 2026-06-30 (text-probe hits in the same ex10-1/ex4-1 exhibits).
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices today's fall, not tomorrow's conversion flow. A floating conversion price is never out of the money, so the supply does not shrink as the price falls. If the market held it fully, the name would show an up-rate after falls near the cross-section's 50%, not 2 of 12.
findings.independence: The Streeterville 13G/A at 9.99% on 2026-08-28 shows conversions have already taken place: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1935172/000185141626000029/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml

outside_window.finding: Nasdaq minimum-market-value deficiency, notified 2026-08-06, with a compliance deadline of 2027-02-01. A delisting risk well outside the window.
A financing cadence of roughly one Streeterville-style note every two months (2026-04-30, 2026-06-30, 2026-08-26) implies another 424B5 around late October. It is not dated and not inside the window.
Serial reverse ADS splits (1:9 in Aug 2024, 1:20 in May 2026, 1:7 in Sep 2026) and a convertible note maturing about 2027-08-26. Continuing long-horizon dilution pressure.
